sector: Contract manufacturing of disposable hygiene products (baby diapers, adult incontinence, sanitary napkins)

company_pe.pat_basis: restated consolidated; wholly owned subsidiaries, all attributable to owners
company_pe.source: RHP p. 170 (Basis for Offer Price); PAT p. 89
company_pe.note: EPS is on about 22.5 crore weighted shares after the 1:5 split and 1:3 bonus (Jan-2026), with the Dec-2025 acquisition shares time-weighted. On the 24.43 crore pre-issue shares FY26 EPS is Rs 3.91 (P/E 28.4x at Rs 111); on the 28.93 crore post-issue shares it is Rs 3.30 (P/E 33.6x). The RHP gives no industry P/E: it states there are no comparable listed peers (p. 170). Band as announced by the company and reported (Upstox, Entrepreneur); the RHP prints [●].

flags: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 86.9 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

business_stage: Scaling (lines up from 12 to 20 FY24-26; two acquisitions in Dec-2025; Rs 554.85 cr new plant under way)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 1-Dec-2026; allocation not yet published at writing

headline: India's largest contract maker of baby and adult diapers (FY26 revenue Rs 1,164 cr, +23%; FirstCry-owner Brainbees holds 76.59% and buys 23% of output), priced at 33.8x FY26 earnings and 49.7x once government grants (47% of FY26 profit) are excluded; DCF fair value Rs 23 (Neutral) because operating margins have fallen from 18.3% to 9.5% while a large plant and working capital must be funded before free cash flow turns positive.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 749.96 / 942.98 / 1,163.90 cr FY24-26 (+25.7%, +23.4%); operating EBITDA margin excl. other income 18.3% / 15.5% / 12.4%, 9.5% in Q1 FY27 (pp. 89, 172)
Government grant income Rs 11.38 / 15.03 / 38.14 cr FY24-26 = 47% of FY26 profit; Rs 103.49 cr receivable at Mar-26 (pp. 42, 90)
Brainbees (76.59% promoter, OFS seller) is the largest customer at 22.6% of FY26 revenue and lends Rs 102.0 cr on demand (pp. 24, 45, 128)
Market share ~38% of baby-diaper and 36% of adult-diaper contract manufacturing in FY26 (p. 168); hygiene market +13% a year to FY30 (p. 208)
CFO 71% of PAT FY24-26; net debt Rs 438.8 cr = 3.0x operating EBITDA; Rs 127.5 cr of the issue repays debt (pp. 90, 136, 172)
Band Rs 105-111; DCF fair value Rs 2.3 / 23.2 / 34.9 vs Rs 111; Dec-2025 acquisition shares issued at Rs 22.50 (pp. 175-176)

strengths: ~38% share of baby-diaper contract manufacturing in FY26 (p. 168)
Brainbees as anchor customer and 76.59% shareholder (pp. 24, 128)
20 lines across baby, adult and feminine hygiene (p. 263)
weaknesses: Operating EBITDA margin 18.3% to 12.4% FY24-26, 9.5% in Q1 FY27 (p. 89)
opportunities: Hygiene market +13% a year to FY30 (p. 208)
Feminine hygiene via KAEHPL, 8.9% of Q1 FY27 sales (p. 262)
threats: Customer insourcing or cancelled purchase orders (p. 25)
Delay or lapse of subsidies; Rs 18.05 cr overdue at Jun-26 (p. 42)
Pulp, nonwoven and polymer cost inflation
Recall of the on-demand Brainbees loan (p. 45)

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the upper band of Rs 111 (as announced by the company and reported): fair value is the DCF alone because the RHP names no comparable listed peer (p. 170). Neutral value Rs 23.2 is 79.1% below the price, below the -30% line, and Bull Rs 34.9 is also below the price (-68.5%), so the Avoid limb applies. At the Rs 105 floor the Neutral value is 77.9% below. It would read Neutral at about Rs 35 or below and Subscribe at about Rs 26 or below. No material issue under the Fund's rules.
reference_note: Band Rs 105-111, lot 135 (company announcement as reported; RHP prints [●]). At Rs 111: 28.93 crore post-issue shares (29.14 crore with ESOPs), market cap Rs 3,212 cr; P/E 33.8x FY26 PAT on diluted shares (49.7x excluding grants and subsidy interest, Rs 65.03 cr); company's own P/E 26.2x (pre-issue weighted shares); P/B 3.1x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 22.1x FY26 operating EBITDA (16.5x on the issuer's KPI EBITDA incl. other income).
